messages:
Maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a 3-day SI flash-readiness pilot (Bootcamp + cert exam) to get 3 partners ready for our marketplace/hardware integrations. Need curriculum, HW lab plan, and press cadence alignment. Thoughts? :wave:

Devon (Solutions Eng): Dates? Also who owns lab access creds and region splits?

Akshay (Training): I can lead curriculum. Proposed outline: Day 0 infra prep, Day 1 model serving + routing, Day 2 ops + troubleshooting, Day 3 certification exam (hands-on + short viva).

Luca (HW Partner - Orion): We can provide a 4-GPU node pool for the cohort in eu-west. Shipping test kits to NA could take 2 weeks. If you need SKUs held, tell me what and when.

Jenna (Product PM): Marketplace listing needs 4 weeks lead time for vendor review + screenshots. If we want joint announcement with Orion, PR windows usually require a headline draft 10 days before release.

Tara (Enablement): Certification rubric: 70% hands-on pass (deploy inference stack + end-to-end perf target), 30% troubleshooting + shorter written section. Suggest a pass/fail + badge + certificate PDF.

ops-bot: Reminder: "Schedule clash detected" — calendar block at 2026-08-02 conflicts with infra maintenance window.

Maria (Partnerships): Good call — avoid maintenance window. Akshay/Jenna, can we aim for cohort week starting 2026-08-16? That gives ~6 weeks prep.

Akshay (Training): 2026-08-16 works for curriculum build. Draft schedule and lab exercises below:

```
Day 0: prereqs + access checks (SSH keys, KMS test, telemetry hooks)
Day 1: model onboarding (quantized variants, kernel selection) + hands-on (deploy model v1)
Day 2: routing, batching, KV cache exercise + failure injection
Day 3: certification (deploy, run eval set, debug) + debrief
```

Devon (Solutions Eng): I'll own lab creds and the enrollment sheet. Volunteers for live debugging in Day 2: Devon, Akshay, Luca (observer).

Luca (HW Partner - Orion): Can do observer and provide remote console. I can also commit 10 reserved hours per cohort for live Q/A.

Jenna (Product PM): I'll start the marketplace intake doc today. Need: 1) hero screenshot, 2) 200-word description, 3) integration checklist. Can someone draft copy?

Tara (Enablement): I'll draft the certification rubric and a short candidate guide (what to prepare). Will share by EOD Friday.

Maria (Partnerships): Action items roundup: @Akshay curriculum + lab exercises; @Devon enrollment + creds; @Tara rubric + candidate guide; @Jenna marketplace intake + announcement draft; @Luca confirm SKUs + reserved hours. I'll coordinate comms and draft announcement copy for partner review.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Enrollment sheet link (internal): https://intra.redwood/apply/si-flash (placeholder). Adding timezone columns and region hardware flags.

Akshay (Training): Small note — exam VM snapshot should include a preinstalled eval harness and one seeded failure case for debugging. We'll provide a troubleshooting checklist.

Luca (HW Partner - Orion): Holding these SKUs for the week of 8/16: ORN-4G-1, ORN-4G-2. Shipping window for NA test kits: earliest 2026-08-01 if order placed by 2026-07-20.

Jenna (Product PM): PR timeline: final announcement draft requested by 2026-08-06, internal review 8/07–8/09, public on 8/17. If anyone needs changes to copy, ping me this week.

Tara (Enablement): One more Q: certification scoring — do we want a partial pass for remediation? Recommend yes: allow 1 remediation lab within 7 days for those who narrowly fail.

Maria (Partnerships): Agree on remediation. We'll offer a single retake window + feedback doc.

Devon (Solutions Eng): I'll set up the Day 2 failure injection harness and the perf targets. Quick question on metrics: what SLA should we require for certified SIs? 99th p50 latency under X?

Akshay (Training): For certification, practical target: 95th p50 under 350ms on the eval harness (on quantized model) and throughput > Y per GPU — we'll fill exact numbers in the rubric draft.

Luca (HW Partner - Orion): Confirmed reserved hours and shipping notes. Also happy to co-review announcement to mention hardware acceleration benefits.

Maria (Partnerships): Perfect. Next sync: short check-in on 2026-07-30 to confirm readiness (curriculum + marketplace assets + hardware hold). I'll calendar invite. :calendar:

Devon (Solutions Eng): +1. I'll paste enrollment link and initial candidate list by 7/25.

Akshay (Training): Will share exercises and exam blueprint by 7/24.

Jenna (Product PM): I'll post the first draft of the announcement copy in this thread by 7/28 for comments.

Tara (Enablement): Rubric + candidate guide by EOD Friday as promised.

Maria (Partnerships): Thanks team — this feels doable. Tagging comms for quick review: @commops when we have draft. Closing thread for now, will reopen with the calendar invite. :rocket:
